membrane_fouling_and_operability_risks: Severe ultrafiltration membrane fouling by insoluble PET microparticles and hydrophobic oligomers (MHET, BHET).
TPA crystallization: Terephthalic acid has low aqueous solubility (<0.02 g/L at 25 °C), precipitating on membranes unless operated at alkaline pH (>8.0).
Alkaline pH operation requires acid neutralizing titration for TPA recovery, generating 1.2 kg sodium sulfate salt waste per kg TPA.
Enzyme thermal denaturation at 50 °C during filtration concentration reduces actual re-usable activity by 15-25% per cycle.
biocatalyst_recycling_analysis.verdict: Enzyme recycling recovers $0.055/kg TPA, but total cost ($1.55/kg) remains 47% above chemical glycolysis ($1.05/kg) due to unavoidable amorphization pretreatment.

strategic_recommendation.justification: FAST-PETase activity at 50 °C is insufficient to overcome PET glass transition barrier (Tg = 65-70 °C). Pre-treatment amorphization adds $0.49/kg TPA, making total enzymatic recycling ($1.60/kg TPA) 52% more expensive than chemical glycolysis ($1.05/kg TPA).
kill_criteria_for_future_reconsideration: Enzyme thermostability Tm must exceed 75 °C to operate at 72 °C where PET chains are mobile.
Enzyme production cost must fall below $10.00/kg pure protein.
Direct depolymerization of 30% crystalline PET must achieve >80% yield without amorphization extrusion.

mass_transfer_and_thiele_regime.engineering_guidance: Observed depolymerization rate is >90% governed by intrinsic enzymatic catalysis. Reported turnover rates can be safely scaled to commercial reactors.

thermal_pinch_and_heat_integration.pinch_verdict: PINCH CONFIRMED at T_hot = 45.0 °C, T_cold = 35.0 °C. Internal heat recovery slashes required boiler steam from 2739 kW to 522 kW (80.9% reduction).
